title: Pitbull Announces 14th Studio Album ‘Pitcoin’
summary: The Miami-born artist, currently on his I'm Back Tour, will take the stage at Billboard Latin Music Week in October.
contentText:
Pitbull is so back. The artist born Armando Christian Pérez is releasing his 14th studio album, titled Pitcoin , Billboard can exclusively report.

The news of the new project, which arrives Oct. 8, comes amid his I’m Back Tour with Lil Jon, which has spanned the United States, Europe, Canada and the United Kingdom. In the U.K., Pitbull helped set the Guinness World Record at London’s BST Hyde Park for the largest gathering of people wearing bald caps, with more than 22,000 participants among a crowd of approximately 70,000 people.

The album release date is still yet to be announced.

The Cuban-American singer-turned-business mogul released his 13th album, Trackhouse , in July 2023. In the meantime, Pitbull has continued to build his business empire, which includes his label, Mr. 305 Records; Voli 305 Vodka; and his SiriusXM channel, Globalization. He has also remained involved in philanthropic efforts, co-founding SLAM! (Sports Leadership Arts Management), a tuition-free public charter school network that currently serves more than 10,000 students across 14 campuses in the United States.

Following the final show of his tour, which takes place Sept. 26 in Shakopee, Minnesota, Mr. Worldwide will head to Miami in October to participate in Billboard Latin Music Week . The artist will join a lineup that includes Greeicy, Jay Wheeler, Jessi Uribe, Kany García, Lola Índigo, Paola Jara, RaiNao, Rawayana, Ryan Castro, Trueno and Zhamira, with more talent to be announced in the coming weeks.

Billboard Latin Music Week will take place at the Faena Forum in Miami Beach from Oct. 19-22. The event is the longest-running, highest-profile and most influential gathering in Latin music. This year’s theme, “Global Consolidation,” will highlight the genre’s continued global expansion through performances, exclusive conversations, panels, workshops, showcases, networking opportunities and fan experiences.

The event will take place in conjunction with the 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards , which will be held Oct. 22 in Miami and air live on Telemundo and Peacock. For more information about Billboard Latin Music Week and tickets, visit BillboardLatinMusicWeek.com .
